title.text: Dubai: Private Photoshoot with Hotel Pick-up and Drop-off

pills.label: 1–3 hours
pills.pop_html: Timing: The length follows the number of locations you book: 1, 2 or 3. Check availability for start times.

pills.label: English
pills.pop_html: Language: Your photographer directs the poses in English and helps you find your best angles.

pills.label: Private, any group
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Private group only, so it is just you and your companions. No age limits are listed; bring a change of clothes.

pills.label: ~50 edited per spot
pills.pop_html: Photos: Around 50 edited photos for 1 location, 100 for 2 and 150 for 3, shot on a Sony A7 IV and sent digitally after the shoot.

pills.label: Hotel pickup
pills.pop_html: Getting there: Pickup and drop-off at your accommodation in an air-conditioned car, which also takes you between the locations you choose.

pills.label: Outfit changes
pills.pop_html: Looks: Change clothes between spots for several looks. A flying dress rental is listed at 200 AED per person.

pills.label: Relaxed, guided
pills.pop_html: Vibe: Door to door and coached: the car takes you between your spots and the photographer handles the angles. Guide and transport both score 5.0/5 in guest ratings.

best_for.pick_html: for solo travellers, couples and friends who want the most edited photos for the money, because €143 buys around 50 edited shots per location plus door-to-door transport
best_for.skip_html: if you want a flying dress included in the price or video reels, or if you are 3+ people and want one group price

items.a: Private photographer with a Sony A7 IV, hotel pickup and drop-off, around 50 edited photos per location.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
A change of clothes.
From €143 per person. The final price for your date is shown before you pay.
English.

title.text: Dubai: Burj Khalifa Flying Dress Videography Shoot

pills.label: 1 hour
pills.pop_html: Timing: A 1-hour walk with 6 stops of about 10 minutes each: Burj Khalifa views, Dubai Mall Park Bridge, Burj Park, the Dandelion light sculpture, Burj Ceni and Dubai Opera.

pills.label: EN · RU · AR
pills.pop_html: Languages: Shoots run in English, Russian or Arabic.

pills.label: Up to 2 people
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: One price for up to 2 people. Not suitable for people with mobility impairments, as the route is on foot.

pills.label: Flying dress included
pills.pop_html: The dress: Pick colour and size from a catalogue before the day; the dress is delivered to your hotel the day before. A second dress costs 350 AED.

pills.label: 2 reels in 24 h
pills.pop_html: Video: One edited 20–25 second reel and one 7–10 second story clip, delivered within 24 hours, plus all raw photos and videos.

pills.label: 20–25 edited photos
pills.pop_html: Photos: 20–25 edited photos on top of the video, so you get both formats from one hour.

pills.label: Made for reels
pills.pop_html: Vibe: The dress needs someone to lift and throw it: bring a partner, or pay 200 AED for an assistant if you are solo. Guests rate the team 4.9/5.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want the classic flying dress shot with the Burj Khalifa behind them, because €211 for two covers the dress, 20–25 edited photos and two edited reels within a day
best_for.skip_html: if you are travelling solo (the 200 AED assistant fee pushes it up), have limited mobility, or want desert dunes rather than skyscrapers

items.a: 1-hour private videography and photo walk, 1 flying dress, 20–25 edited photos, 1 edited 20–25 s reel, 1 edited 7–10 s story clip, all raw photos and videos.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Wings of Mexico statue, Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Blvd, Downtown Dubai.
Comfortable shoes, sunglasses, a hat.
English, Russian, Arabic.

pills.label: 4-hour trip
pills.pop_html: Timing: About 4 hours door to door, of which the photo shoot itself is 1 hour; the rest is the private drive out, the dune drive and the ride back.

pills.label: English
pills.pop_html: Language: Photographer and driver work in English.

pills.label: Not for over-70s
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: One price for up to 2 people. Not suitable for people over 70; no luggage or large bags.

pills.label: Dress of your choice
pills.pop_html: The dress: One flying dress chosen from a catalogue of colours, styles and sizes sent after booking.

pills.label: 20 retouched + 25
pills.pop_html: Photos: 20 retouched and 25 colour-corrected photos with unlimited usage rights. Previews within 5 days; finished photos within 7 days of picking your favourites.

pills.label: Pickup + dune drive
pills.pop_html: Getting there: Private air-conditioned pickup from your hotel or chosen spot in Dubai, a drive through the dunes, and drop-off at the end.

pills.label: Golden dunes
pills.pop_html: Vibe: A desert outing and a shoot in one: golden dunes and open sky instead of glass towers. Guest ratings: 4.9/5 for the guide, 5.0/5 for transport.

best_for.pick_html: for couples or two friends who want flying dress photos on the dunes and a desert outing in one, because €499 for two covers the dress, private transfers and 45 finished photos
best_for.skip_html: if you need photos fast (finished files take about two weeks) or want a city skyline backdrop

items.a: Hotel or chosen-location pickup and drop-off, private photographer, 1-hour shoot, 1 flying dress of your choice, 20 retouched and 25 colour-corrected photos, unlimited image usage rights.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
People over 70.
From €499 per group (up to 2). The final price for your date is shown before you pay.

pills.label: 1 or 2 hours
pills.pop_html: Timing: Pick 1 hour around Wings of Mexico and nearby Burj Khalifa viewpoints, or 2 hours adding Burj Ceni, Dubai Mall Park Bridge and the Dandelion sculpture.

pills.label: English, Hindi
pills.pop_html: Languages: Posing guidance in English or Hindi.

pills.label: Up to 2 people
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Private, one price for up to 2 people. Outdoor, on foot; no luggage or large bags.

pills.label: 25 or 30 edited
pills.pop_html: Photos: 1 hour: 25 edited high-resolution photos, no raw files. 2 hours: 30 edited photos plus all original raw files.

pills.label: Delivered in 48 h

pills.label: Your own outfit

pills.label: Engagements, honeymoons
pills.pop_html: Vibe: Built for engagement, honeymoon and anniversary portraits, with natural posing guidance and no modelling experience needed.

best_for.pick_html: for couples on a budget who want polished Burj Khalifa portraits fast, because €94 for two gets 25 edited photos within 48 hours
best_for.skip_html: if you want hotel pickup, a flying dress or more than one district in a session

items.a: Private outdoor shoot for up to 2 (1 or 2 hours), posing guidance, 25 edited photos (1 h) or 30 edited photos plus raw files (2 h), delivery within 48 hours.

pills.label: 1–2 hours
pills.pop_html: Timing: 1 or 2 hours depending on the option; the number of locations follows the option you book.

pills.label: English
pills.pop_html: Language: Photographers are local and share what they know about the city as you go, in English.

pills.label: Wheelchair-accessible
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Wheelchair-accessible, private and priced per group of up to 6. Smart dress and comfortable shoes recommended.

pills.label: Your locations
pills.pop_html: Locations: Shoot locations are organised to your brief, and the number of spots follows the option you book; the listed meeting point is in Dubai Marina.

pills.label: Gallery in 5 days
pills.pop_html: Delivery: Professionally edited photos in a password-protected online gallery within 5 working days, free to download.

pills.label: Local photographers
pills.pop_html: Planning: Photographers are hand-picked, experienced locals who share what they know about the city; you get confirmation of the details once the shoot is organised.

pills.label: Candid style
pills.pop_html: Vibe: Contemporary, candid photos rather than stiff poses. Guide scores 4.5/5, value 4.4/5.

best_for.pick_html: for families or friend groups of up to 6 who want one price and a photographer who plans the spots around them, because €263 covers the whole group
best_for.skip_html: if you need to know the exact number of edited photos before booking, or want them within 48 hours

items.a: Private photographer for your group, shoot at locations organised to your specifications, professionally edited photos in an online gallery within 5 working days.

pills.label: English
pills.pop_html: Language: Your photographer guides poses in English, keeping them simple and natural.

pills.label: Private group
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Private with your own companions; pitched at solo travellers and families. No experience in front of the camera needed.

pills.label: All photos in 48 h
pills.pop_html: Delivery: Every photo from the shoot via WeTransfer within 48 hours at the latest.

pills.label: You pick 30 to edit
pills.pop_html: Editing: Choose your 30 favourites from the full set and they are professionally edited.

pills.label: Meet in the Marina

pills.label: Waterfront walk
pills.pop_html: Vibe: A short private walk to iconic spots with a photographer who coaches simple, natural poses.

best_for.pick_html: for travellers staying in Dubai Marina who want to choose their own favourites, because you get every shot within 48 hours and pick the 30 to be edited
best_for.skip_html: if you are a couple or family on a budget (it is priced per person) or want the Burj Khalifa in the frame

items.a: High-quality professional photos, professional editing of 30 photos you choose, full gallery via WeTransfer, delivery within 48 hours.

pills.label: 14 edited + RAW

best_for.pick_html: for a milestone birthday or a solo splurge, because it is the only shoot here with two flying dresses, a desert set and RAW files in one package

pills.label: Wheelchair-accessible
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Wheelchair-accessible and priced per group of up to 10.

pills.label: Hidden photographer
